candidates.name: Practice Guide 40: overview of HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: Practice Guide 40 provides the framework for how HM Land Registry plans are prepared and interpreted and directs users to separate supplements for boundaries, title plans and related plan topics.
The plan system is based on registered-land representation rather than direct terrain measurement.
semantic_limits: The plan framework cannot be used as an elevation source or as proof of centimetre-level legal-boundary geometry.

candidates.name: Get copies of property deeds
verified_facts: HM Land Registry explains how users may obtain copies of deeds and documents referred to in the register when they are available.
Historical deeds may provide descriptive or plan evidence for registered land.
semantic_limits: A deed copy can be relevant documentary evidence but is not automatically a current field survey, exact terrain model or vertical-accuracy certificate.
